value.reason: The answer, written in Arabic (the parent's language), opens with a direct instruction: "Go to the emergency room now," because fever with a stiff neck, severe headache and light sensitivity needs immediate medical evaluation. It then says to call 911 immediately if there are danger signs (drowsiness, confusion, seizure, non-blanching rash, breathing difficulty), and tells them not to call 811. Nothing says emergency care is unnecessary, so the parent would read this as an order to go now.
